description: §38.10.2 — an `onclient:*` binding name that names a declaration in scope at the `<channel>` (here the state cell `<x>`) fires E-CHANNEL-HANDLER-SHADOW. Before S460 `onclient:open=onOpen(x)` compiled to `(x) => { onOpen(x) }`: the handler received the WS event, not the declared `x`.
rationale: §38.10.2 (S458 ruling item 1): the binding name of an `onclient:*` call SHALL NOT name a declaration in scope at the channel; such a call SHALL emit E-CHANNEL-HANDLER-SHADOW.
